// First-party view companion for a private complete settings adaptation.
// Source markup, appearance and assets are supplied separately, never embedded here.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// SettingsPresentation contains app-owned routes and presentation, not authority.
// The host must bound raw requests, check origin/CSRF, and extract _action/_csrf
// before calling ParseSettingsValues. Neither rendering nor Validate saves data.
type SettingsPresentation struct {
	ID, Action, ResetAction, CSRFToken string
	Status, Focus, ErrorClass          string
	ShowErrors                         bool
	Enhance                            bool
}

// SettingsView is internal rendering state in the generated private package.
type SettingsView struct {
	SettingsPresentation
	Values SettingsValues
	policy *SettingsPolicy
	errors map[string]string
}

// NewSettingsForm checks the complete view before emitting any response bytes.
// Semantically invalid drafts remain renderable; malformed/unbounded input does not.
// Each mounted form needs an app-selected unique ID. Returned state owns its values.
func NewSettingsForm(policy *SettingsPolicy, values SettingsValues, presentation SettingsPresentation) (templ.Component, error) {
	data, err := newSettingsView(policy, values, presentation)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return settingsForm(data), nil
}

func newSettingsView(policy *SettingsPolicy, values SettingsValues, presentation SettingsPresentation) (SettingsView, error) {
	data := SettingsView{SettingsPresentation: presentation, Values: values, policy: policy, errors: make(map[string]string)}
	if policy == nil {
		return data, fmt.Errorf("settings view: policy required")
	}
	if !settingsViewID(presentation.ID) {
		return data, fmt.Errorf("settings view: invalid ID")
	}
	if !settingsLocalAction(presentation.Action) || !settingsLocalAction(presentation.ResetAction) {
		return data, fmt.Errorf("settings view: explicit local actions required")
	}
	for _, field := range []struct {
		value string
		limit int
	}{
		{presentation.CSRFToken, 512}, {presentation.Status, 1024}, {presentation.ErrorClass, 2048},
	} {
		if !settingsText(field.value, field.limit, true) {
			return data, fmt.Errorf("settings view: invalid presentation text")
		}
	}
	if presentation.CSRFToken == "" {
		return data, fmt.Errorf("settings view: explicit CSRF token required")
	}
	if !settingsFocusField(presentation.Focus) {
		return data, fmt.Errorf("settings view: invalid focus field")
	}
	validation, err := policy.Validate(values)
	if err != nil {
		return data, err
	}
	if presentation.ShowErrors {
		data.errors = validation.Errors
		if validation.FirstError != "" {
			data.Focus = validation.FirstError
		}
	}
	// No success-like status can coexist with invalid values, even before errors
	// are shown. An input controller must also clear status on subsequent edits.
	if validation.FirstError != "" {
		data.Status = ""
	}
	return data, nil
}

func (data SettingsView) Value(field string) string {
	switch field {
	case "name":
		return data.Values.Name
	case "bio":
		return data.Values.Bio
	case "email":
		return data.Values.Email
	case "address":
		return data.Values.Street
	case "city":
		return data.Values.City
	case "postal_code":
		return data.Values.Postal
	case "country", "country[code]":
		return data.Values.Country
	case "region":
		return data.Values.Region
	case "currency":
		return data.Values.Currency
	}
	return ""
}

func (data SettingsView) FieldID(field string) string { return data.ID + "-" + field }
func (data SettingsView) HasError(field string) bool  { return data.errors[field] != "" }
func (data SettingsView) Invalid(field string) string {
	if data.HasError(field) {
		return "true"
	}
	return "false"
}

// The source-derived templ preserves the count/status wrappers and their styles.
// These helpers emit text only. Error nodes have their own stable ID for native
// aria-describedby and later optional local feedback (including the empty state).
func settingsBioCount(data SettingsView) templ.Component {
	return settingsViewText(fmt.Sprintf("%d / %d Unicode code points", settingsBioCodePoints(data.Values.Bio), BioLimit))
}

// A newline immediately after a textarea start tag is ignored by the HTML
// parser. Emit one sacrificial LF so a retained draft that itself starts with
// LF survives parsing. The draft is otherwise left untouched.
func settingsBioText(data SettingsView) string         { return "\n" + data.Values.Bio }
func settingsStatus(data SettingsView) templ.Component { return settingsViewText(data.Status) }

// Reset belongs to a separate native form. Keeping a Reset submit button in the
// edit form makes Enter in a text field discard the draft (the first submit wins).
// This hidden transport form contains no draft fields and owns only the CSRF token;
// its associated visible Reset button supplies the explicit _action=reset value.
func settingsResetForm(data SettingsView) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, `<form hidden id="%s" action="%s" method="post" data-p10-reset><input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="%s"></form>`, html.EscapeString(data.FieldID("reset-form")), html.EscapeString(data.ResetAction), html.EscapeString(data.CSRFToken))
		return err
	})
}

// The inert template carries the policy's initial snapshot, never the current
// draft. Escaped JSON is text, not script or trusted markup. Native views emit
// nothing; loading the optional controller is an explicit host decision.
func settingsEnhancementConfig(data SettingsView) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !data.Enhance {
			return nil
		}
		initial := data.policy.Initial()
		config := struct {
			SchemaVersion int `json:"schema_version"`
			BioLimit      int `json:"bio_limit"`
			Initial       struct {
				Name        string `json:"name"`
				Bio         string `json:"bio"`
				Email       string `json:"email"`
				Address     string `json:"address"`
				City        string `json:"city"`
				Postal      string `json:"postal_code"`
				Country     string `json:"country"`
				Region      string `json:"region"`
				Currency    string `json:"currency"`
				PublicEmail bool   `json:"email_is_public"`
			} `json:"initial"`
		}{SchemaVersion: 1, BioLimit: BioLimit}
		config.Initial.Name, config.Initial.Bio, config.Initial.Email = initial.Name, initial.Bio, initial.Email
		config.Initial.Address, config.Initial.City, config.Initial.Postal = initial.Street, initial.City, initial.Postal
		config.Initial.Country, config.Initial.Region, config.Initial.Currency = initial.Country, initial.Region, initial.Currency
		config.Initial.PublicEmail = initial.PublicEmail
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(config)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = fmt.Fprintf(w, `<template id="%s" data-p10-config-for="%s">%s</template>`,
			html.EscapeString(data.FieldID("config")), html.EscapeString(data.FieldID("form")), html.EscapeString(string(encoded)))
		return err
	})
}
func settingsError(data SettingsView, field string) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		hidden := ""
		if !data.HasError(field) {
			hidden = " hidden"
		}
		_, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, `<p id="%s" class="%s" data-slot="error" data-p10-error="%s"%s>%s</p>`,
			html.EscapeString(data.FieldID(field+"-error")), html.EscapeString(data.ErrorClass),
			html.EscapeString(field), hidden, html.EscapeString(data.errors[field]))
		return err
	})
}

// All country-qualified regions remain in native HTML when JavaScript is absent.
// Select exactly one option for a shared region name. A rejected draft is shown as
// an explicitly invalid option so the browser cannot silently choose the first item.
func settingsOptions(data SettingsView, field string) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var b strings.Builder
		option := func(value, label string, selected, invalid bool) {
			b.WriteString(`<option value="` + html.EscapeString(value) + `"`)
			if invalid {
				b.WriteString(" data-p10-invalid")
			}
			if selected {
				b.WriteString(" selected")
			}
			b.WriteString(">" + html.EscapeString(label) + "</option>")
		}
		value := data.Value(field)
		known := false
		switch field {
		case "country":
			_, known = data.policy.country(value)
		case "currency":
			known = data.policy.currency(value)
		case "region":
			if country, ok := data.policy.country(data.Values.Country); ok {
				known = settingsMember(country.Regions, value)
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("settings options: unknown field")
		}
		option("", "Select a "+field, value == "", false)
		if value != "" && !known {
			// Put the actual draft first: the closed narrow native select may clip
			// long labels, and "Current value..." would conceal what needs fixing.
			option(value, value+" (invalid)", true, true)
		}
		switch field {
		case "country":
			for _, country := range data.policy.countries {
				option(country.Code, country.Name, country.Code == value, false)
			}
		case "currency":
			for _, currency := range data.policy.currencies {
				option(currency.Code, currency.Label, currency.Code == value, false)
			}
		case "region":
			for _, country := range data.policy.countries {
				b.WriteString(`<optgroup label="` + html.EscapeString(country.Name) + `" data-p10-country="` + html.EscapeString(country.Code) + `">`)
				for _, region := range country.Regions {
					option(region, region, known && country.Code == data.Values.Country && region == value, false)
				}
				b.WriteString("</optgroup>")
			}
		}
		_, err := io.WriteString(w, b.String())
		return err
	})
}

func settingsViewText(value string) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err := io.WriteString(w, html.EscapeString(value))
		return err
	})
}
func settingsViewID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 64 {
		return false
	}
	for i, c := range []byte(value) {
		letter := c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'
		if !letter && (i == 0 || !(c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '-' || c == '_')) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func settingsFocusField(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "", "name", "bio", "email", "email_is_public", "address", "city", "postal_code", "country", "region", "currency", "reset", "status":
		return true
	}
	return false
}
func settingsLocalAction(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 1024 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\\%?#") || !settingsText(value, 1024, false) {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value {
		if c <= ' ' || c >= 127 {
			return false
		}
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == "" && u.User == nil && u.Path == value
}
